text: On project open in list view, scroll to the current phase in the rightmost column
description: On project open in list view: if this browser stored its column and selection state, reopen exactly that most recent position; fall back to the active (current) phase path only when there is no stored state. Felix 2026-11-01 replaced the earlier 2026-10-26 request (always jump to the current phase in the rightmost column). Note: per-column scroll offsets are not stored; restoring scrolls each column to its restored selection.

status.comment: 5aec0b2a reverts e6df8faf: the pre-existing behavior (browser state wins, cursor chain only without it) is what Felix asked for on 2026-11-01. Covered by list-store.spec ('restores this browser's own selection…', 'follows the cursor chain … without saved state').
